## Verification evidence

- [ ] Unit/integration tests cover the changed behavior
- [ ] Customer-visible failures include a correlation/incident ID

- [ ] Authorization/RLS/Storage access was reviewed when applicable
- [ ] No secret or customer data is present in logs or fixtures
